description: The Pre-Heaven Bagua (先天八卦) as eigenprompt — an octagonal cosmogram deployed to shape phase space for cognitive work that the Taijitu cannot reach. Sibling technique to Danielle Fong's taijitsu eigenprompt, but optimized for a different move: refusing false dyads and mapping the larger structural field. Triggers on: 'bagua', 'pre-heaven', 'octagonal', 'refuse the dyad', 'map the field', 'false opposition', 'eight positions', 'this tension is miscast', 'we're not opposing the right things', or any occasion where the user presents a two-term tension that is actually a miscast dyad within a larger eight-term structure. Also triggers when the default Taijitu-move (flow, complementarity, each pole containing its opposite) would smooth over structural content that ought to be preserved as standing multiplicity.
